metadata.description: PindeX — structural codebase indexer for token-efficient AI coding.

plugins.name: pindex
plugins.description: Structural codebase indexer (MCP): search_symbols, get_file_summary, find_usages, get_dependencies + passive session memory. Cuts token usage on medium-to-large codebases (break-even ~40+ files). Self-configuring, no per-project setup.
